description: Run-time configuration changes, including one at the same time as a modem event, start no timer and produce no output while nothing is queued.
note: A changed value is read when next used and no change restarts a timer or re-seeds the PRNG (core-architecture.md section 7.3). The config input at 5000 comes before the modem input at 5000 by class order (section 4.5).
